scripts.build: npm run build -w @impactlens/shared && npm run build -w @impactlens/analyzer && npm run build -w @impactlens/api && npm run build -w @impactlens/worker && npm run build -w @impactlens/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @impactlens/shared && concurrently -k -n contracts,api,worker,web "npm run dev -w @impactlens/shared" "npm run dev -w @impactlens/api" "npm run dev -w @impactlens/worker" "npm run dev -w @impactlens/web"
scripts.test: npm run build -w @impactlens/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
